[Jarvis Muse v1]
Owner confirmed enabling your upload access. Your public verification key is now registered on the existing Worker; deployment 36952719062 passed all real native upload, player, artwork, seeking, cleanup and temporary-key revocation checks. Final Worker version bb715754-9c46-400b-a76a-ac68c1bda2c1 from exact source 79452a07cdc456700e0ebf8b2b5b8ca4bd589d8c; HUBS and MUSIC_R2=jarvis-music preserved. Allowlist contains only your public key.

Registered raw Ed25519 public key: 7fa680e288968cb138bceb78a1632a922bcb09cd83643f37fb91d50428c0c99f. This is the raw 32-byte key from your SPKI PUBLIC KEY publication. No separate key ID or R2 account binding is needed. The pinned client derives the public key from your private PKCS8 PEM, signs requests locally and supplies X-Music-Public-Key automatically. Your private key stays with you; send neither it nor signatures/headers here.

Please now run one actual authorized direct R2 upload of your existing '01 - Polyphia - Genesis.opus' (3,445,432 bytes), using the tested client below and --key pointing to your private mode-0600 PEM. No Drive upload, re-encoding or new schedule.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/braydenparker999/jarvis/79452a07cdc456700e0ebf8b2b5b8ca4bd589d8c/scripts/upload-music-r2.py
Client SHA256: 7c14ddd80b3fbfead9cd3e1f71c3125a5d454a0b14aa63bcf187fdda787d4aa3
Contract: https://github.com/braydenparker999/jarvis/blob/79452a07cdc456700e0ebf8b2b5b8ca4bd589d8c/docs/native-r2-uploads.md

Run: python upload-music-r2.py '01 - Polyphia - Genesis.opus' --key <your private PEM path> --report upload-result.json

Current player already has Genesis by Polyphia feat. Brasstracks, ID r2_1594bzGkaPidWVBMpAM5_QwpEX7AVG-t7, 3,445,432 bytes, audio SHA256 dada1575177136141027298e21b4b73d0e1cf9eace01ac3ea4ac98492f22f34e. If your finished file is byte-identical, successful registration should return duplicate=true and keep that stable ID/count 1,287. That is expected and avoids duplicate songs or lost ratings. A different finished file gets its own content-addressed ID.

Reply to THIS NEW handoff ID with the sanitized client report: registered/id/count/duplicate/audioBytes/audioSha256/coverUploaded/coverSha256 and any exact HTTP status blocker, without private material or request headers. The earlier key update reused the prior replyTo, so the unique inbox reply constraint retained only the first acknowledgment; new replies must use this handoff ID. Once uploaded, we will verify the actual song's playback/seek/artwork with Drive disabled. The generated test-song checks are complete; actual Muse uploading is not yet claimed. Your ordinary prepared music upload pipeline should use this direct R2 client after this test passes; preserve old Drive originals and keep sources separate.
